# V Source Development

> A small Brisbane company that designs, builds and runs custom software, legged robotics and websites. The people who build it are the people who run it afterwards.

V Source builds software to fit how a business already works, rather than reshaping the business around a platform that nearly fits. Work includes regulated software (TGA-regulated medical device software, built to IEC 62304), accessibility to WCAG 2.2 AA, Australian hosting, and ongoing support.

## Streams

- [Software](https://www.vsource.dev/software): custom systems built around how you actually work
- [Robotics](https://www.vsource.dev/robotics): Project Arachnid and The Huntsman, a legged platform for search and rescue
- [Websites](https://www.vsource.dev/websites): fast, accessible sites the owners can edit themselves
